description: The bar chart illustrates the Execution Accuracy of two methods, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across four different categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories in the order of Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Execution Accuracy," using a linear scale with a visible range from 20 to 60 and tick marks at regular intervals of 10. The chart features grouped vertical bars, where each category contains a pair of bars placed side-by-side. According to the legend at the top, light blue bars represent NatSQL and dark blue bars represent TA-SQL. Exact numerical values are annotated above most of the bars. In the "Simple" category, NatSQL is 60.21 and TA-SQL is the tallest bar in the chart at 63.14. For the "Moderate" category, the NatSQL bar is uniquely depicted with a light blue base and an unannotated grey upper segment reaching approximately 42 on the vertical axis, while the TA-SQL bar is annotated at 48.60. In the "Challenging" category, NatSQL represents the shortest annotated bar at 32.32, and TA-SQL is 36.11. For the "Total" category, NatSQL is 51.35 and TA-SQL is 56.19. The bars are arranged by categorical grouping rather than sorted by height, and the numerical annotations serve as visual emphasis for the specific data points, with the exception of the unannotated NatSQL bar in the Moderate category.
